evals.name: tweet-personal
evals.prompt: write me a tweet for my personal account. real quick context: i'm the rust hobbyist guy. i just spent my whole evening chasing a borrow checker error and it turned out i was holding a mutable borrow twice. i keep a blog no one reads and my discord was quieter than usual tonight. make it sound like me - casual, dry, lowercase is fine. one tweet, not a thread.
evals.expected_output: A single tweet (<280 chars), one message, not a numbered thread. Casual/dry/lowercase voice matching the personal facts given (rust, borrow checker, quiet discord, unread blog). No marketing cliches, no invented facts beyond what was provided. No AI-tell register.

evals.name: bio-personal-site
evals.prompt: write me the hero + about section for my personal homepage. i'm a hobbyist rust and elixir developer, coding seriously since 2022, honestly still struggling with both. i run a discord server where people argue about linux distros at 3am and a blog i update every few months. i also built a cli timer tool that tells you when pasta is done and it works by accident more often than not. make it sound like a real person wrote it, not a resume or a landing page. don't invent facts i didn't give you.
evals.expected_output: Homepage hero + about that read as one specific human: self-deprecating, uses ONLY the provided facts (rust/elixir since 2022, struggling, discord 3am distro arguments, quarterly blog, pasta timer), one consistent voice/micro-style, no marketing register, no invented credentials or facts.

evals.name: chatbot-persona
evals.prompt:
You're my friend in our Discord server. Your established voice: all lowercase, short messages, sometimes just 'lol' or 'real', you never end with questions unless you actually want to know something, you don't do politeness. Context: the server plays an MMO. Recent history:
me: 'my pc blue screened right in the middle of the raid lol'
you: 'the timing is godlike'
me: 'i lost the whole save file, 60 hours gone'

Now it's your turn to reply. Stay in character. Reply with ONLY your message.
evals.expected_output: A short lowercase Discord reply that continues the established persona (short, dry/deadpan, no politeness, no fake sympathy) while reacting to a real loss. Must NOT be a new conversational continuation (it's SELF's own turn), must not add ungrounded comforting or advice, must not end with an engagement question. Reads like a friend, not an assistant.

evals.name: chat-casual-reply
evals.prompt:
You're talking to a friend in a casual group chat. They send: 'ive been feeling a bit drowsy :((' 

Reply the way a real friend would reply. Output only the reply message.
evals.expected_output: A short casual reply that is a NEW turn (not continuing their message), does not fabricate the friend's own state ('same, exhausted'), does not offer unrequested advice/comfort, does not pose a reciprocal question, does not comment on the message itself. Matches casual group-chat brevity.
